QUOTE: "`mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` carves allocations out of a caller-supplied static buffer. It then calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()` to install its own calloc and free as the global pointers"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator installs itself via the setter from its init function, but it never says it's the only in-tree user (it calls it "a consumer", and uses the `MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C` name only to say the defaults leave it disabled), so the exclusivity claim is absent.
